entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-05-30
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • NullReferenceException in dotnet workload install when a feed URL contains leading whitespace #49211
  • dotnet test completely ignores command line parameters #49210
  • `dotnet format` cannot format source files of .csproj (using old syntax) if Mono is installed #49208
  • 15 misspellings of capabiltities vs capabilities #49207
  • 17 misspellings of instatiate vs instantiate #49206
  • Simplify dotnet run file without `run` #49202
  • Support piping code directly into `dotnet run` via stdin #49201

Closed

  • [Feature] Add a `#:project` directive to `dotnet run` to include a project as a dependency #49196

PullRequests

Created

  • [Experiment] Add ability to manage Local SDKs in the SDK #49209
    Area-Infrastructure

Updated

  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #49080
    Area-CodeFlow, Area-Roslyn
  • [release/10.0.1xx-preview5] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #49125
  • [StaticWebAsset] Exclude source maps from updating fingerprinted blazor.js #49178
    Area-AspNetCore, 10.0.1xx
  • stop using System.CommandLine types that aren't public anymore #49181
    Area-CLI
  • Exploration of ideas for supporting multiple files in dotnet run file #47672
    Area-Infrastructure, untriaged, Area-run-file
